title: I Released the First Alpha of My AI-Assisted Unity ARPG
author: henry_the_fifth
selftext:
I’ve been spending the last few months experimenting with AI-assisted game development workflows while building a dark fantasy ARPG in Unity called Grimstone Keep.

This weekend I finally released the first public alpha build. It includes:

 - 3 dungeon levels
 - combat and boss fights
 - loot/item generation
 - leveling/progression
 - inventory/equipment systems
 - save/load systems

AI tools helped accelerate a lot of the iteration, prototyping, debugging, and content pipeline work, but the biggest thing I learned is that they still don’t replace judgement, taste, balancing, or the messy reality of actual game development.

I also put together a devlog/playthrough video showing the current state of the game and some behind the scenes looks at how the systems are wired together in Unity.

Would genuinely love feedback from other developers experimenting in this space.
